description: Implementation of the GroupTreeWidget class managing hierarchical groups (categories, tags, system groups) in a Qt application, including initialization, modification, addition, removal, and serialization of group data.

classes.name: GroupTreeWidget
classes.description: A Qt widget class for managing hierarchical group structures such as categories, tags, and system groups within the application.

methods.name: appendToGroupModelMap
methods.description: Adds or updates a GroupModel in the specified map based on name and count.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the widget with note models and loads group data from files.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new group if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Decreases the count of a specified group.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a group and updates related notes accordingly.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Increases the count of a specified group.

methods.name: modify
methods.description: Changes the name of a group and updates associated notes.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a GroupModel to the tree widget.

methods.name: setItemSelected
methods.description: Selects the current group based on configuration.

methods.name: removeOne
methods.description: Removes a specific group model.

methods.name: getTreeWidgetItem
methods.description: Retrieves a tree widget item by group type and name.

methods.name: getGroupModel
methods.description: Retrieves the GroupModel associated with a tree widget item.

methods.name: onItemChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to item text, updating models accordingly.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Decrements counts for note models in the tree.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Increments counts for note models in the tree.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes group data to a string for storage.

methods.name: getGroupModelList
methods.description: Returns a list of all group models of a specific type.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a group with specified type and name exists.

methods.name: saveDataToLocal
methods.description: Saves category or tag list to local files.

methods.name: getGroupModelList
methods.description: Returns a list of all group models including categories and tags.

methods.name: selectedGroupModel
methods.description: Returns the currently selected group model.
